mechanism_narrative: RETAIL_REC has improved for three consecutive weeks, and this positive momentum persists because mobility habits adjust slowly; the next four-week mean will exceed the last four-week mean.
evidence_refs: fact:RETAIL_REC rose from -22.0 to -20.0 over four weeks
failure_condition: The mean of RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is less than or equal to the mean over the last 28 days despite RETAIL_REC improving for three consecutive weeks.

mechanism_narrative: RESIDENTIAL has fallen from 6.0 to 3.6, meaning fewer people stay home; when RESIDENTIAL drops below 4.0, out-of-home trips increase enough to lift RETAIL_REC over the next week and beyond.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL falls below 4.0 for two consecutive weekly means
failure_condition: RESIDENTIAL stays below 4.0 for two weeks but the next 28-day mean of RETAIL_REC is not higher than the last 28-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: WORKPLACES has recovered from -23.9 to -22.1, indicating that reopening policy is bringing commuters back; this commuting revival raises weekday retail footfall and pushes RETAIL_REC higher over four weeks.
failure_condition: WORKPLACES is above -22.5 but the next 28-day mean of RETAIL_REC is lower than the last 28-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: TRANSIT and WORKPLACES jointly signal a return of commuting and errands; when both TRANSIT exceeds -37.5 and WORKPLACES exceeds -22.5, retail footfall accelerates and RETAIL_REC rises over four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT improved to -37.1 and WORKPLACES to -22.1
failure_condition: Both TRANSIT > -37.5 and WORKPLACES > -22.5 hold, yet the next 28-day mean of RETAIL_REC is lower than the last 28-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: PARKS has declined from 55.0 to 45.0, a seasonal shift away from outdoor recreation; as outdoor activity normalizes downward, discretionary spending rotates back to retail stores and lifts RETAIL_REC over four weeks.
failure_condition: PARKS falls below 45.0 but the next 28-day mean of RETAIL_REC is not higher than the last 28-day mean.

evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM stable near -16 while RETAIL_REC rose to -20.0
failure_condition: GROCERY_PHARM stays between -17.0 and -15.0 and RETAIL_REC rises week-on-week, but the next 28-day mean of RETAIL_REC is lower than the last 28-day mean.
